scripts.text: Phew, those young people nowadays, are so rude and have no manners.
scripts.translation: 唉，現在的年輕人真沒禮貌，一點規矩也沒有。

scripts.text: ....?? You are not like other young people. You have good manners! You know what happened to me..?
scripts.translation: ...？你和其他年輕人不一樣，很懂禮貌！你知道我遇到什麼事了嗎？

scripts.text: I was on the way to visit my son who lives in Rune-Midgarts. It's really far away, so I took the airplane, and..
scripts.translation: 我本來要去看住在盧恩-米德加爾特的兒子。路途太遠，所以我搭了飛艇，然後...

scripts.text: those young people...so noisy.... I was standing but none of them offered me a seat..and they were just talking loudly which bothered everyone.
scripts.translation: 那些年輕人...吵死了...我一直站著，卻沒人給我讓座...他們還大聲喧譁，吵得大家都不得安寧。

scripts.text: I could lecture them if I were 10 years younger..
scripts.translation: 要是我年輕十歲，非得好好訓他們一頓...

scripts.text: Pffff.. Never liked the passing of time....
scripts.translation: 唉...我從來都不喜歡歲月流逝...

scripts.text: So, you... what would you do??
In an open, public place, you are supposed to stay quiet to the destination and offer your seat to the elderly and the infirm.
scripts.translation: 在公共場所應該保持安靜，抵達目的地後還要給老人和病弱者讓座。

scripts.text: Once I was walking in the town and some boys were spitting on the street and were bothering girls who were passing by...tut tut!
scripts.translation: 有一次我在城裡散步，幾個小夥子在街上吐痰，還騷擾路過的女孩...嘖嘖！

scripts.text: The world is going to the dogs.. How will it be?? It was even day time when they were doing it..tut tut.
scripts.translation: 世風日下啊...以後可怎麼辦？他們竟然大白天就做這種事...嘖嘖。

scripts.text: Oh, and then you know what...?

scripts.text: Lately young people are not so patient!!!!

scripts.text: So often they say they will quit.. they say they can't do more. How will they live life with that kind of mentality..tut tut.
scripts.translation: 他們動不動就說要放棄，說自己做不下去了。抱著這種心態，以後可怎麼生活...嘖嘖。

scripts.text: It's not easy to find a job. It is very difficult to be hired but then they even cannot stand a week there and leave the work place.

scripts.text: Hm......You are not like common young people, you seem pretty patient too. I like that!!!

scripts.text: Now I am just an weak old man but when I was young I was a famous merchant in the town.
scripts.translation: 如今我只是個虛弱的老人，但年輕時可是鎮上有名的商人。

scripts.text: It's been a while since I stopped the business,
scripts.translation: 我已經歇業有一陣子了，

scripts.text: but a former client of mine contacted me and asked me
scripts.translation: 不過以前的一位客戶聯絡我，問我

scripts.text: If I could get him some unknown objects named 'Will of Warrior', 'Thirst for Blood', and 'Chill of the Dead'.

scripts.text: I like your politeness which most young people don't have, so if you get me those, I will give you some stuff that I consider as my treasure.
scripts.translation: 我喜歡你的禮貌，現在的年輕人很少有這份禮貌。如果你幫我找到那些東西，我就把一些視為珍寶的物品送給你。

scripts.text: When I gather them, I will come back

scripts.text: Which are the equipments found so far?
Hey, excuse me, but I'm not from Umbala! You are so rude.
scripts.translation: 喂，打擾一下，我不是烏龜島來的！你真沒禮貌。

scripts.text: As you can see I'm a training Sorcerer, and my name is Pudding.
scripts.translation: 如你所見，我是個見習妖術師，我叫布丁。

scripts.text: ... What's that face? I'm starting to feel unpleasant..
scripts.translation: ...你那是什麼表情？我開始不高興了...

scripts.text: A couple of days ago while I was undergoing discipline, I felt a strange, bizarre tinge. So I followed that and it brought me here.
scripts.translation: 幾天前我在修行時，感到一股奇異的氣息。循著氣息追蹤，我就來到了這裡。

scripts.text: OK, let me continue. I become bothered if you disturb me while I'm talking.
scripts.translation: 好，我繼續說。講到一半被打斷，我會很煩的。

scripts.text: And I entered to the laboratory here in order to investigate and oh gosh! I found those monsters which were like doppelgangers from 'Geffen Dungeon'. It was full of them.
scripts.translation: 我進了這裡的實驗室調查，天啊！裡面滿是和‘蓋芬地下城’裡相似的怪物，簡直像它們的分身。

scripts.text: From those monsters, I could find rare items like '^F2766EWill of Warrior^000000', '^952420Thirst for Blood^000000', and '^88C6F7Chill of the Dead^000000' which you cannot find in any other place.
scripts.translation: 從那些怪物身上，我找到了其他地方都沒有的稀有物品，例如‘^F2766E戰士意志^000000’、‘^952420嗜血慾望^000000’和‘^88C6F7死者寒氣^000000’。

scripts.text: And after many hours of research on my own, I finally figured out a way to use those items. Do you wanna know?
scripts.translation: 經過數小時獨自研究，我終於找到使用這些物品的方法。想知道嗎？

scripts.text: Of course, I really wanna know.
Oh my! You fell asleep after you asked me something? Well, anyway I feel lazy to explain again so I will just continue.
scripts.translation: 哎呀！你剛問完就睡著了？算了，我懶得再解釋一遍，繼續說吧。

scripts.text: Good, I am content that you are listening to my story carefully. Then I will keep explaining.
scripts.translation: 很好，看你認真聽我說，我就繼續講下去。

scripts.text: Those '^F2766EWill of Warrior^000000' and '^952420Thirst for Blood^000000'..... are aggressive but warm materials.
scripts.translation: ‘^F2766E戰士意志^000000’和‘^952420嗜血慾望^000000’...是充滿攻擊性卻又溫熱的材料。

scripts.text: So '^F2766EWill of Warrior^000000' can dwell a special power to the 4th slot of an equipment,
scripts.translation: 所以‘^F2766E戰士意志^000000’可以為裝備第4插槽注入特殊力量，

scripts.text: and '^952420Thirst for Blood^000000' can dwell a special power to the 3rd slot.
scripts.translation: 而‘^952420嗜血慾望^000000’可以為第3插槽注入特殊力量。

scripts.text: '^88C6F7Chill of the Dead^000000' is a cold type material
scripts.translation: ‘^88C6F7死者寒氣^000000’則是一種冰冷的材料，

scripts.text: which allows the return of power from '^F2766EWill of Warrior^000000' or '^952420Thirst for Blood^000000' so makes the equipment no longer enchanted.
scripts.translation: 可以移除‘^F2766E戰士意志^000000’或‘^952420嗜血慾望^000000’賦予的力量，讓裝備恢復未附魔狀態。

scripts.text: What do you say? Doesn't it sound interesting? But, there's a problem...
scripts.translation: 怎麼樣？聽起來很有趣吧？不過有個問題...

scripts.text: Since those materials can only be found from the monsters in the Lab., the special power also can be dwelt into certain equipments which can be obtained from the Lab.
scripts.translation: 這些材料只能從實驗室的魔物身上取得，所以特殊力量也只能注入實驗室中獲得的特定裝備。

scripts.text: Gee.. I told you not to cut while I talk, didn't I? Well, I will answer that because that's important.
scripts.translation: 唉...我不是說過別打斷我嗎？算了，這個問題很重要，我還是回答吧。

scripts.text: If you bring me 10 '^F2766EWill of Warrior^000000' or 10 '^952420Thirst for Blood^000000', I will dwell some power to certain equipments that you can find in the Lab..
scripts.translation: 帶來10個‘^F2766E戰士意志^000000’或10個‘^952420嗜血慾望^000000’，我就能為你在實驗室找到的特定裝備註入力量。

scripts.text: And if you are not satisfied with the power you got, bring me 10 '^88C6F7Chill of the Dead^000000', and I will take off that power.
scripts.translation: 如果你對獲得的力量不滿意，再帶來10個‘^88C6F7死者寒氣^000000’，我就能移除它。

scripts.text: What do you say? Having both options.....quite nice, huh?
scripts.translation: 怎麼樣？兩種選擇都有...很不錯吧？

scripts.text: If you obtain '^F2766EWill of Warrior^000000' or '^952420Thirst for Blood^000000', and obtain also equipment which is capable to accept their power, bring them to me. I will be waiting.
scripts.translation: 如果你拿到了‘^F2766E戰士意志^000000’或‘^952420嗜血慾望^000000’，也找到了能接受其力量的裝備，就帶來給我。我會等著你。

scripts.text: Hm.... Equipment which are discovered so far are....
Pudding takes some paper out from a pocket.
scripts.translation: 布丁從口袋裡拿出一張紙。

scripts.text: Let me see.. the equipments discovered until now are....
scripts.translation: 我看看...目前發現的裝備有...

scripts.text: Ok, I don't have to know more.
scripts.translation: 好的，我不需要知道更多了

scripts.text: If you obtain '^F2766EWill of Warrior^000000' or '^952420Thirst for Blood^000000', and obtain also equipment which is capable to accept their power, bring them to me. I will be waiting.
scripts.translation: 如果你拿到了‘^F2766E戰士意志^000000’或‘^952420嗜血慾望^000000’，也找到了能接受其力量的裝備，就帶來給我。我會等著你。

scripts.text: So far these are the Armors discovered. Do you wanna see other things?
scripts.translation: 目前發現的防具就是這些。還想看別的嗎？

scripts.text: So far these are the Weapons discovered. Do you wanna see other things?
scripts.translation: 目前發現的武器就是這些。還想看別的嗎？

scripts.text: OKAY! In which equipment you want to dwell the power?
scripts.translation: 好！你想把力量注入哪件裝備？

scripts.text: Well, I was looking forward to doing it, but I cannot help then.
scripts.translation: 唉，我本來很期待幫你製作，不過也沒辦法。

scripts.text: Well.. You have nothing equipped on the left hand.
scripts.translation: 嗯...你左手沒有裝備任何東西。

scripts.text: Well.. You have nothing equipped on the right hand.
scripts.translation: 嗯...你右手沒有裝備任何東西。

scripts.text: Hey.. Are you not wearing any helm?
First! I need to check if this equipment can accept the power.
scripts.translation: 首先！我得確認這件裝備能不能接受力量。

scripts.text: Hm.... This equipment cannot accept the power of '^F2766EWill of Warrior^000000' or '^952420Thirst for Blood^000000'.
scripts.translation: 嗯...這件裝備無法接受‘^F2766E戰士意志^000000’或‘^952420嗜血慾望^000000’的力量。

scripts.text: OHHH.. This equipment could accept the power of '^F2766EWill of Warrior^000000' or '^952420Thirst for Blood^000000'.
scripts.translation: 哦哦...這件裝備可以接受‘^F2766E戰士意志^000000’或‘^952420嗜血慾望^000000’的力量。

scripts.text: OK! Which power do you want to dwell into your equipment?
scripts.translation: 好！你想給裝備註入哪種力量？

scripts.text: I say no! I don't need that!!
Ohhh.. I was looking forward to doing it, but it's all up to you......
scripts.translation: 唉...我本來很期待幫你處理，不過由你決定吧...

scripts.text: Not enough '^F2766EWill of Warrior^000000'. You need to bring 10 '^F2766EWill of Warrior^000000'
This equipment already has the power of '^F2766EWill of Warrior^000000'.
scripts.translation: 這件裝備已經注入了‘^F2766E戰士意志^000000’的力量。

scripts.text: Not enough '^952420Thirst for Blood^000000'. You need to bring 10 '^952420Thirst for Blood^000000'
This equipment already has the power of '^952420Thirst for Blood^000000'.
scripts.translation: 這件裝備已經注入了‘^952420嗜血慾望^000000’的力量。

scripts.text: Alright, which power do you want to remove?
scripts.translation: 好吧，你想移除哪種力量？

scripts.text: No, I don't wanna remove any.
scripts.translation: 不，我不想移除任何力量

scripts.text: Not enough '^88C6F7Chill of the Dead^000000'. You need to bring 10 '^88C6F7Chill of the Dead^000000'
This equipment didn't get any special power.
scripts.translation: 這件裝備沒有獲得任何特殊力量。

scripts.text: The power of '^952420Thirst for Blood^000000' has been perfectly removed.
scripts.translation: ‘^952420嗜血慾望^000000’的力量已成功移除。

scripts.text: The power of '^F2766EWill of Warrior^000000' has been perfectly removed.
scripts.translation: ‘^F2766E戰士意志^000000’的力量已成功移除。

scripts.text: Before I dwell the power, let me caution you.
scripts.translation: 注入力量之前，我先提醒你。

scripts.text: While I dwell the power of '^F2766EWill of Warrior^000000' or '^952420Thirst for Blood^000000', the equipment could be not capable of accepting it and will be destroyed as a result..
scripts.translation: 注入‘^F2766E戰士意志^000000’或‘^952420嗜血慾望^000000’的力量時，裝備可能無法承受，最終會被摧毀...

scripts.text: ^9D2628If the equipment is destroyed, you will also lose the cards you inserted in it, and the refine Lv will be removed too.^000000
scripts.translation: ^9D2628如果裝備被摧毀，插入其中的卡片也會一併消失，精煉等級也會歸零。^000000

scripts.text: Alright. Do you really wish to dwell the power into the equipment?
scripts.translation: 好，你確定要將力量注入這件裝備嗎？

scripts.text: OK. I hope to see you again.
I hope you made the correct decision...
scripts.translation: 希望你做出了正確的決定...

scripts.text: ...Well....the equipment could not accept the power of {0} and it got destroyed.
scripts.translation: ...唉...裝備無法承受{0}的力量，因此被摧毀了。

scripts.text: Fortunately, the power of {0} has been dwelt well into your equipment...
scripts.translation: 幸好，{0}的力量成功注入了你的裝備...
